name: hr-management-module
description: HR Management Module with NestJS backend and React Vite frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
